reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) supports lattice distortion and W-rich precipitate formation in AlCoCrFeNiWx coatings, but the hypothesis applies these mechanisms to a different base alloy (CoCrFeNi vs. AlCoCrFeNi) and a much wider temperature range (RT–800 °C vs. only 800 °C tests), with no direct evidence for a self-adaptive oxide/glaze layer or low-friction performance at lower temperatures.

W addition promotes formation of W-rich intermetallic precipitates
